the visual design factors can be used to manipulate the feelings that customers have when they are using a cyber-banking system.

the design of customer interfaces for electronic commerce systems in terms of their visual design factors and their impact on the feelings of customers using these systems.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
it is possible for the interface designer to design a user interface for a cyber-banking system that will evoke target emotions in the customer.
the design of the interface should be done with the user's emotional experience as the main goal, rather than the functionality of the system.

the emotional usability of a customer interface can be designed by considering the emotional factors and visual design factors of that interface.
